sentence: Betting on the Philippines We at the BSP remain optimistic about the Philippine economy's prospects, especially as economic activity continues to gain traction across the globe.
label: positive

sentence: According to the latest figures released by the IMF, global GDP growth reached 3.8 percent in 2017, the fastest pace since 2011 as investment and trade continued to pick up.
label: positive

sentence: The IMF now forecasts the global economy to grow by about 3.9 percent in 2018 and 2019, as accommodative policies support the stronger growth impulses in advanced and emerging economies alike.
label: positive

sentence: However, we continue to monitor developments that could dampen this growth momentum.
label: negative

sentence: These include increased trade protectionism, rising geopolitical tensions, and the possibility of heightened financial stresses owing to the onset of monetary policy tightening in a number of economies especially in the U.S.
label: negative

sentence: Even with these downside risks, we remain confident about our own prospects.
label: positive

sentence: The Philippine economy is coming off another banner year.
label: positive

sentence: Real GDP expanded by 6.7 percent in 2017.
label: positive

sentence: This is the sixth consecutive year that the economy had grown by over 6.0 percent.
label: positive

sentence: The IMF also shares our optimism, as it forecasts the Philippine economy to expand by about 6.7 percent in 2018 and 6.8 percent in 2019.
label: positive

sentence: This is not far from the National Government's target of 7.0-8.0 percent growth over the next three years.
label: neutral

sentence: All these paint the Philippines as one of the more dynamic and fastest-growing economies in Asia.
label: positive

sentence: We have also observed that growth has become more broad-based over the years.
label: positive

sentence: Along with the services sector, manufacturing and construction have emerged as potent drivers of output.
label: positive

sentence: On the demand side, increased capital investments and public spending, especially since the past year, have complemented robust private consumption in stimulating economic activity.
label: positive

sentence: Meanwhile, amid rapid economic growth, the inflation environment has remained manageable.
label: positive

sentence: Except for 2015 and 2016 when the decline in international oil prices tempered inflationary pressures, inflation has settled within the announced target ranges since 2009.
label: positive

sentence: Thus far in 2018, headline inflation has averaged 3.8 percent (using the new 2012 Consumer Price Index series).
label: neutral

sentence: For 2018, our latest forecast estimates average inflation at 3.9 percent.
label: neutral

sentence: This is near the high end of our target range of 2-4 percent for 2018-2019.
label: neutral

sentence: So this bears careful watching.

sentence: Nevertheless, we see inflation moderating and reverting to around 3 percent by 2019, the midpoint of the target range.

sentence: We expect the confluence of strong growth and stable inflation being sustained over the medium term.
label: positive

sentence: Specifically, as the National Government pours in more investments into physical infrastructure and increases expenditure in soft investments in our young population to provide them with higher quality education, skills development and better health services, the economy's productive capacity will improve further.

sentence: These will help boost productivity and we can expect further accelerated growth in potential output.
label: positive

sentence: Meanwhile, various safety net programs to mitigate the impact of recent tax reform measures, especially on the vulnerable sectors of society, should also help moderate inflationary pressures in the immediate term.
label: positive

sentence: We also believe that these public investments in physical infrastructure and human capital are sustainable because they are supported by prudent fiscal management.

sentence: The first wave of tax reforms under the TRAIN Law, in particular, should help generate additional revenues to finance the Government's programs.
label: positive

sentence: Reforms to encourage tax compliance, improve revenue collections, and plug regulatory loopholes, among others, are also in the pipeline to further strengthen the country's fiscal position.

sentence: 273 on 27 February 2001.

sentence: Secretary Camacho, Secretary Perez, distinguished members of the Singaporean Financial Community, honored guests, ladies and gentlemen, good afternoon.

sentence: As you have heard from Secretary Camacho, the Philippines has an economic plan focused on fiscal discipline, good governance, market-oriented reform, and poverty-reduction.

sentence: As the Governor of the Central Bank, I would like to reiterate my support for this plan and its implementation and also my confidence that there is a team and a strategy in place to ensure that the objectives included in the economic plan will be achieved.

sentence: Allow me, therefore, to spell out the initiatives that we, at the Central Bank, have been taking to support the Government's economic plan.
label: neutral

sentence: Our efforts have been directed in three important areas: first, achieving price stability; second, introducing banking sector reforms; and third, introducing institutional reforms to pave the way for the good governance practices that will assist in making the Philippine economic plan a reality.
label: positive

sentence: Price Stability To my mind, one of the most crucial steps being taken by the Arroyo Administration is the emphasis on instilling fiscal discipline throughout the public sector.
label: neutral

sentence: The ability to meet revenue and expenditure targets, and thus reduce the budget deficit, are significant challenges that must be accomplished.
label: neutral

sentence: While also addressing rampant speculative activity in some quarters of the financial markets.
label: neutral

sentence: While the Government is focused on instilling fiscal discipline, my team in the Central Bank has also been concentrating on restoring calm to the currency markets.
label: neutral

sentence: I am pleased to say that we have seen some initial success in this very important area.
label: positive

sentence: Our goal in this regard is to achieve overall price stability and to continue to support the Government in meeting its fiscal targets.
label: positive

sentence: As many of you are aware, our currency, the peso, like many other currencies around the world, has been the object of some speculative pressure.
label: negative

sentence: In addressing this pressure, we have taken a two-fold approach to our currency challenges by reducing liquidity levels in the market through hikes in liquidity reserve requirements, and by being diligent and relentless in warding off speculators.
label: positive

sentence: We have done this by exposing banks and by imposing fines when they are found to have violated foreign exchange regulations.
label: neutral

sentence: Our efforts have resulted in a strengthening of the peso from a low of PhP 53.57 to the U.S. dollar three weeks ago to its current level of close to PhP 51.
label: positive

sentence: A relatively stable exchange rate is important for keeping inflation under control and is good for business planning.
label: positive

sentence: Our next step is to ensure that price stability becomes the norm rather than the exception.
label: neutral

sentence: To achieve this, the Central Bank will be implementing a number of institutional measures.
label: neutral

sentence: Those measures include: A shift in monetary policy to inflation-targeting by January of next year.

sentence: This practice, which is employed by many other countries, has price stability as a primary focus.

sentence: It achieves that stability by committing to reach an explicit nominal inflation target directly without compromising the broad economic targets of the government.

sentence: This differs from the present practice of using a monetary aggregate targeting framework, which uses money supply as an intermediate target.

sentence: Other institutional measures that we are taking include the preservation of an appropriate interest-rate differential to encourage investors to maintain their peso denominated assets.

sentence: This policy, however, must be supported by a strict and effective foreign exchange monitoring system and a strong commitment to apply penalties to institutions or individuals who violate foreign exchange regulations.

sentence: And finally, our efforts to support price stability include work we are carrying out to develop secondary markets for fixed income and derivative products.

sentence: Instituting Banking Reforms The Central Bank is also committed to increasing foreign participation in the Philippine banking sector.

sentence: As such, we will soon introduce reforms to prepare domestic banks to effectively compete in a globally integrated banking environment.
label: positive

sentence: The reforms will fall within the framework of first, improving the banking sector's structure; secondly, enhancing the Central Bank's supervisory and regulatory powers in line with international standards; thirdly, heightening bank transparency and disclosure; fourthly, improving risk management; and finally, stimulating the consumer-oriented credit environment.

sentence: Our work to strengthen the banking sector through such steps as imposing capital requirements in accordance with international standards and by promoting greater competition will certainly encourage banking sector consolidation and provide opportunities for greater foreign participation in the sector.

sentence: In heightening bank transparency and disclosure, the Central Bank will monitor the banks' selection of external auditors and require strict adherence to the "Know your customer rule".

sentence: In improving risk management, the Central Bank will institute an early warning system for bank failures, assist banks to better match their foreign currency assets and liabilities, and carry out reviews to identify regulatory loopholes in the transactions of bank-affiliated FOREX corporations.

sentence: For this reason, we are seeking amendments to the Central Bank Charter that will institutionalize many of these reforms and reinforce the position of the central bank as a governing and independent body for monetary policy and supervision.

sentence: We also want to strengthen criminal and administrative penalties for any violation of banking laws, and to introduce measures that will increase the Central Bank's operational efficiency.

sentence: Finally, I am very optimistic that we will soon see the passage of an Anti-money Laundering Bill in both the Philippine Congress and Senate.

sentence: This is something that the Central Bank has been working on over the past several months.
label: neutral

sentence: I would like to assure you that this bill is being taken very seriously and has gained popular support not just in the legislative arena, but also amongst the general public.
label: positive

sentence: Let me make it perfectly clear, the Central Bank is committed to promoting and enforcing international standards of banking regulation and supervision.
label: positive

sentence: Because of this, we have zero tolerance for illegal practices such as money laundering.
label: neutral

sentence: These are not empty words.
label: neutral

sentence: My Central Bank team and my colleagues in government will be steadfast in instituting the reforms that will strengthen our banking sector and promote good governance.
label: positive

sentence: My former associates and colleagues in the Philippine banking sector can certainly attest to my determination to work with the Government to achieve its growth targets.

sentence: And while I am holding the reins at the Central Bank, good governance policies and practices will be non-negotiable.

sentence: Before I close and take your questions, I would just like to reiterate that we recognize that restoring the Philippine economy to health is a significant challenge.

sentence: Introduction: The Analytics of Banking Governance Ladies and gentlemen, good evening.

sentence: The theme of tonight's discussion is The Establishment of an Adequate Infrastructure for the Effective Governance in the Banking System.
label: neutral

sentence: Banks and other financial institutions by virtue of their deposit and borrowing functions are custodian of the country's liquid reserves.
label: neutral

sentence: As such, they play an important role in the efficient functioning of a modern economy.
label: positive

sentence: They constitute a system that serves as a pooling mechanism for savings and an efficient allocation device that channels these funds to the most productive economic activities.
label: positive

sentence: Any disruption in the intermediation process by the financial system will inevitably lead to negative effects on the whole economy.
label: negative

sentence: There is, therefore, strong public interest in the safety and liquidity of the banking system's financial condition.
label: positive

sentence: As such, much attention has been devoted to the issue of building a strong and stable financial system.
label: neutral

sentence: In the recent Asian regional financial crisis, among the factors identified to be behind the collapse of some of the banking systems in the region has been the inadequacies in the corporate governance of banks.
label: negative

sentence: Its been said that one of the lessons from the 1997 Asian debacle is that good governance of banks is an essential element of a sound banking system.
label: neutral

sentence: Moreover, the financial sector has grown remarkably in recent years to even exceed the size of the real sector.
label: positive

sentence: Elements of Good Corporate Governance of Banks [1] Corporate governance refers to the set of rules that define the relationships between shareholders, managers, creditors, government and other stakeholders and a set of mechanisms that help directly or indirectly to enforce these rules.
label: neutral

sentence: [2] Good governance, whether applied to banks or non-bank corporates, is essential for a well functioning economy as it provides incentives for management to act in ways that raise the firm's net present value and assure shareholders an adequate return.
label: positive

sentence: At the same time, good corporate governance can help create an environment conducive to the sustained growth of the industry - in this case the banking system.
label: positive

sentence: To be sure, a good governance structure in the banking system by itself cannot build a strong and stable financial system on its own.
label: negative

sentence: It needs to be complemented by, among other things, similarly appropriate governance structures in the regulatory agencies and the general corporate sector.
label: positive

sentence: Good governance at the individual bank level hinges in part on the business practices adopted by the board of directors and management.
label: neutral

sentence: A competent management is the first line of defense against excessive risk taking by banks.
label: neutral

sentence: Most bank failures can be attributed to inadequate management that allows the bank to acquire low quality assets and take inappropriate risk positions, and that fails to detect and resolve deterioration in existing assets and risk positions.
label: negative

sentence: Briefly, some of the key elements of a good governance system at the individual bank level are: Management that possesses high integrity and has adequate training and experience; Good internal information and control system to ensure that decisions affecting the rights and obligations of the bank never rest with just one individual; Prudent credit approval procedures and risk limitation procedures; and Effective external and internal audit procedures to ensure that established policies and procedures are followed and special interests are not allowed to influence decisions.
label: positive

sentence: Let me focus on the elements of good corporate governance at the industry level.
label: neutral

sentence: Specifically, what are some of the factors that can contribute in the creation of an environment conducive to the adoption of good governance practice by banks?
label: neutral

sentence: Independent and capable banking supervisors A key element of good governance of the banking industry is the quality of governance of monetary authorities and bank supervision agencies as the regulators set an example for the industry and as they are able to effectively perform their responsibilities/functions/duties.
label: positive

sentence: The importance of independence of bank supervisors has been emphasized in the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) paper entitled "Core Principles For Effective Banking Supervision" which states that "an effective system of banking supervision will have clear responsibilities and objectives for each agency involved in the supervision of banking organizations.
label: neutral

sentence: Each such agency should possess operational independence and adequate resource."
label: neutral

sentence: Adequate bank rating system The traditional system of analyzing and rating the soundness of financial institutions used by regulators, supervisors, credit rating agencies or corporate analysts has been the camel methodology.
label: neutral

sentence: Bank soundness is evaluated based on capital adequacy, asset quality, management capability, earnings potential and liquidity.
label: neutral

sentence: However, this methodology may not be able to fully cover the entire range of governance risks faced by banks.
label: negative

sentence: Thus, there is a need to augment the camel methodology to include explicitly governance as a risk factor.
label: neutral

sentence: This can be done, for example, by taking a closer look at the board of directors in terms of independence, accountability, interlocking interests, integrity, experience and ability to assume their duties, among other things.
label: neutral

sentence: Active merger and consolidation market A more dynamic industrial environment characterized by an active merger and acquisition market can also induce good governance in banks.
label: positive

sentence: The threat of a corporate takeover or a merger should provide an impetus for the adoption of appropriate governance practices.
label: positive

sentence: To facilitate merger and consolidation activities, issues such as the limits on foreign ownership of banks, existence of dual classes of shares and tax and accounting regulations hampering mergers should be addressed.
label: neutral

sentence: Effective anti-corruption framework The campaign to improve governance practices in banks should be accompanied by an anti-corruption framework that is strictly enforced by the relevant agencies.
label: positive

sentence: Banks are often a target of corruption activities such that bank collapse often blamed on some form corrupt practice.
label: negative

sentence: One of the core principles for effective supervision of banks identified by the BIS relates to connected lending, a form of corruption in banks.
label: neutral

sentence: The BIS core principles for effective banking supervision states that "in order to prevent abuses from connected lending, banking supervisors must have in place requirements that banks lend to related companies and individuals on an arm's length basis such that extensions of credit are officially monitored, and that other appropriate steps are taken to control or mitigate the risks."
label: neutral

sentence: Others Other factors essential to the creation of an environment for the good governance of banks are: the codification of the fiduciary duties of care and loyalty and the liabilities of bank directors; the requirement for banks listed in the stock exchange to disclose their governance practices as part of their annual reports; and the promotion of education, training and information on governance and professional directorship.

sentence: BSP Towards an Environment of Good Governance How does the Philippines rate against these elements of good governance?

sentence: In a number of regional conferences I have attended, the observation has been made that the Philippines has fared relatively better than some other countries during the financial crisis.

sentence: In some cases, mergers have been resorted to.

sentence: Together with the change in emphasis towards a risk-based approach, significant improvements have taken place in the area of rating methodologies.

sentence: In July 1998, "sensitivity to market risk(s) was added to arrive at a camels rating system".

sentence: Others Other reforms include the intensified bank monitoring of selected banks especially those in potential distress.
label: neutral

sentence: The BSP has also adopted explicit procedures to be used when banks fail to reach certain thresholds of capital adequacy.
label: neutral

sentence: External auditors of banks have been required to report to the BSP all matters that could adversely affect the financial condition of their clients, any serious irregularity that may jeopardize the interest of depositors and creditors, and any losses incurred which substantially reduce bank's capital.

sentence: Stricter provisioning regulations have also been put in place.
label: neutral

sentence: How have these actions by the regulators been perceived by the observers?
label: neutral

sentence: An independent assessment made recently by Goldman Sachs found that prudential standards in the Philippines remained strong and compare favorably with the standards used in the Asian region.

sentence: Moreover, the performance of the Philippine banking system in terms of NPL, profitability and capital adequacy during the crisis was generally positive.

sentence: These reflect in part the good governance structure existing in the Philippine banks.

sentence: Let me quote part of that report, "bank managements are generally seasoned and cautious, having gone through a decade of economic depression and political upheaval.

sentence: We also regard the BSP as a more transparent and effective regulator among Asian banks, though continued closer, preemptive supervision of bank is vital.

sentence: Concluding Remarks In the last decade, the banking system has undergone a substantial period of reform not only to build a culture of good corporate governance but also to achieve the broader goal of strengthening the banking system.

sentence: Nevertheless, its importance should not be underplayed since the consequences can be costly or catastrophic in the worst case.

sentence: Being an intangible asset, good governance requires attention and investment of time, money and the need for recourse to sources of professional governance expertise and advice."
label: neutral
